critique: The pulsing coral-toned squid, cyan/magenta bioluminescent colonies, and drifting bubbles create a compelling cyber-natural apparition within the gilded Baroque triptych and tenebrist cavern. The hard polygonal god-rays and foreground rock silhouettes feel noticeably flatter than the atmospheric water and inset art panel; irregular erosion, refracted edges, and light-responsive texture would make these layers cohere more organically.
